programme.title: Arvin Mitchell
programme.desc: With an array of impressions, stories, gestures and faces, Arvin's memorable performance is sure to please. As the former co-host of BET's Club Comic View, Arvin has been featured on Kevin Heart's “One Mic Stand”, Tony Rocks “The Funny Spot” as well as entertaining our troops abroad. Nominated as one of NBC's Stand Up for Diversity top comics Arvin continues to tour colleges, clubs, cruise ships & churches.

programme.title: Zoltan Kaszas
programme.desc: Zoltan Kaszas was born in Budapest, Hungary and raised in San Diego, California. He first stepped onstage at the age of nineteen and he was hooked immediately. Zoltan's diverse background and life experience along with his conversational storytelling style has been entertaining audiences at comedy clubs and colleges across the country. His comedy has also been featured on the television show Laughs on FOX, on radio at SiriusXM in print in The Atlantic and has helped him win The Seattle International Comedy Competition &The San Diego Comedy Festival. When he isn't traveling the world Zoltan can be found at home with his wife Brittany and their cat Jessica, you can keep up with him on his weekly podcast available on iTunes called This Week In Zoltan.

programme.title: Brian Moote
programme.desc: Brian Moote started performing stand up in 2005 while he was working as a teacher in the Seattle School District. He then went to graduate school to get a masters degree in social work because who doesn't love crippling debt? I mean, this is America. After graduating he moved to LA and now tours the country telling jokes. He has made TV appearances on the USA Network's "Characters Welcome," Nickelodeon's "Nickmom's Nite Out," MTV's "Money from Strangers" and AXS TV's "Gotham Live." You should come out and see him tell jokes... DO IT!!!

programme.title: Mike Speenberg
programme.desc: Mike Speenberg has been a professional touring Stand-up comedian for 20 years. He's performed on 5 different continents, entertained everyone from Hall of Fame Athletes to US Diplomats, shared the stage with everyone from Robin Williams to Bill Burr, and been featured on everything from CNN to the AMERICAN FORCES RADIO NETWORK.

programme.title: Andrew Rivers
programme.desc: Andrew's very personal and fun storytelling comedy, combined with his exemplary work ethic has earned him high praise from some of the best comedians in the business. Andrew is a featured writer, actor, and comedian on the TV show “UpLate NW.” Andrew has been featured on NBC, FOX, and the Bob & Tom Radio Show and is a regular opening act for Christopher Titus. Andrew was also featured on the popular Buzzfeed web series “Truth or Drink“, has performed in over 35 states and his new podcast called “Don't Quit Your Night Job” was featured in the Seattle Times.

programme.title: Collin Moulton
programme.desc: Collin is one of the most fun, personable, and sought after headliners today. He has had his own stand-up special on SHOWTIME, he's been on NICKELODEON, and was recently featured on LAST CALL WITH CARSON DALY. Touring for over 15 years Collin has gained an ease and enjoyment on stage that makes every show worth watching.America knows and loves him. His familiarity and energy engages and relieves the audience before he even speaks. His electric storytelling style makes you care about every topic he explores. Collin's comedy is the release needed from our every day lives. Come needing to laugh tonight, leave wanting to laugh forever!Collin Moulton

programme.title: Costaki Economopoulos
programme.desc: For 20 years Costaki has been living his dream as a full-time stand up comic. He has written jokes for Bette Midler, Jay Leno, MTV, and BET. You may have seen him on Showtime or heard him on Sirius, but you probably know him best from his regular appearances on the nationally syndicated Bob & Tom Radio Show.

programme.title: The Animals That Changed History
programme.desc: From cats and dogs to pigs and even camels, with animals by our side humanity was ready to conquer the world.

programme.title: Shark Divers
programme.desc: Discover one of the most dangerous jobs in the world...shark diving!

programme.title: Fish Wars
programme.desc: Fish Wars will give you a unique insight into the battle to protect Asia’s oceans from illegal fishing.

programme.title: Last Lion Of Liuwa
programme.desc: A haunting roar echoes across the Liuwa Plain. There is no answer, there hasn't been for years. She has no pride, no support - she alone must safeguard her own survival. She is Lady Liuwa, the Last Lioness.

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 1"
programme.desc: The rains have arrived, and the desert has never looked better. Cleo, the boss of this group of wild meerkats has given birth to five new pups, but some of them quickly get lost or snatched away. Only the toughest survive here in the African desert.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Who’s A Reptile?"
programme.desc: Snakes, lizards, alligators, and turtles reveal the diversity of reptiles, their shared characteristics, and the features that make each group unique.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "The Kingdom of the Horse"
programme.desc: Take a look at the horse, its many breeds, remarkable sizes and long history with humans, alongside donkeys, zebras, tapirs, rhinos & other relatives.

programme.title: Chris Humfrey's Animal Instinct S1 - "Wild Discoveries"
programme.desc: Chris searches for forest dragons, encounters a giant python, and reveals an extraordinary animal with a very unusual survival skill.

programme.title: Chris Humfrey's Animal Instinct S1 - "Animal Adventures"
programme.desc: Chris collects ostrich eggs, cares for baby emus and owls, and begins a new breeding program for endangered mountain pygmy possums.

programme.title: Chris Humfrey's Animal Instinct S1 - "Tree Kangaroo Quest"
programme.desc: Chris heads to Far North Queensland to care for tree kangaroos and search for some of Australia's rarest wildlife.

programme.title: The Animal Communicator
programme.desc: Anna Breytenbach has dedicated her life to what she calls interspecies communication. She sends detailed messages to animals through pictures and thoughts.

programme.title: Camp Raiders
programme.desc: Meet the 'Trash Can Clan' doing their daily round of the dustbins in South Africa's most famour national park, the Kruger.

programme.title: Python Hunters S1 - "The Perfect Storm"
programme.desc: The Python Hunters decide to tackle the debate over how the Burmese Pythons came to be established in the Everglades.

programme.title: The Best Of Worlds: Life At Its Alpine Limits
programme.desc: The Alps are home to plants and animals that owe their success to an amazing capacity to live in conditions that for other species, would be barely tolerable. For them however, this is everyday life.

programme.title: End of the Big Cats S1 - "Lion"
programme.desc: Prosecuted for many decades, Africa’s lion population has declined to only twenty thousand, and many biologists and conservationists are starting an international campaign to save these extraordinary animals.

programme.title: End of the Big Cats S1 - "Leopard"
programme.desc: Leopards are more resistant to extinction because of their elusive behaviour. Leopards are solitary creatures, the quintessential ambush-and-stalking predator, able to find the most remotes places on earth to avoid human contact.

programme.title: End of the Big Cats S1 - "Cheetah"
programme.desc: Cheetahs have already survived one extinction, estimated to have been around 10,000 years ago. Now, seen as a pest by farmers, and hunted vigorously, the cheetah is perilously close to a second exit.

programme.title: Feel the Heat
programme.desc: Life has harnessed the power of the sun, but the dramatic forces of fire and drought challenge the survival of plants and animals.

programme.title: Sumatra's Last Tigers
programme.desc: With Sumatran tigers near extinction, their habitat in decline and humans on the menu, this film shows two top predators living on the same piece of land. The tigers that are being pushed to the brink and the humans risking everything to save them.

programme.title: Creepy Crawlies S1 - "Army"
programme.desc: Creepy crawlies can form armies to help them build elaborate homes, raise their young and hunt their prey.

programme.title: Secret Life Of The Circler
programme.desc: The journey of the rare and beautiful raptor, the black harrier, from egg to fledging and role of the female while nesting, a time when the mother and her chicks are at their most vulnerable to predators.

programme.title: The Cost Of Progress
programme.desc: Growth and innovation can be a marvelous thing, but at what cost to our one and only planet, and the creatures that we share it with?

programme.title: Saving the Mustang - America's Horse on the Brink
programme.desc: Saving The Mustang explores the state of wild horses today through the efforts of three individuals. All stories interweave a compelling tale of perseverance and determination.

programme.title: All The Presidents Elephants
programme.desc: Sharon Pincott, from Queensland, Australia, ditches her friends and material possessions to pursue a dangerous life in Robert Mugabe’s Zimbabwe – as caretaker of the ‘presidential herd’ of elephants.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "The Dangerous Dry Season"
programme.desc: Echo lives in Southern Kenya alongside 1,500 other wild African elephants. Below Kilimanjaro, no rain has fallen. There’s no grass to eat, so Echo must find food for her hungry family.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "Threat to a Leader"
programme.desc: Norah and Soila race to Amboseli’s outlands to help rescue Qualida, an elephant matriarch trapped in mud. In her secret spot, Echo wakes to face a rebellion: half her family leave to eat at the palms.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Baby Owls S1 - "Episode 1"
programme.desc: In an abandoned WWI airfield in rural Essex lives Missing Claw, Geronimo and Flo. Over the course of winter, spring and early summer, we get a privileged view of their secret lives using a special camera rig outside, and inside their nests.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Baby Owls S1 - "Episode 1"
programme.desc: In an abandoned WWI airfield in rural Essex lives Missing Claw, Geronimo and Flo. Over the course of winter, spring and early summer, we get a privileged view of their secret lives using a special camera rig outside, and inside their nests.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Baby Owls S1 - "Episode 2"
programme.desc: In an abandoned WWI airfield in rural Essex lives Missing Claw, Geronimo and Flo. Over the course of winter, spring and early summer, we get a privileged view of their secret lives using a special camera rig outside, and inside their nests.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Baby Owls S1 - "Episode 2"
programme.desc: In an abandoned WWI airfield in rural Essex lives Missing Claw, Geronimo and Flo. Over the course of winter, spring and early summer, we get a privileged view of their secret lives using a special camera rig outside, and inside their nests.

programme.title: Wild Iberia S1 - "Spring"
programme.desc: The sun heats the earth and life begins again. The animals wake from hibernation and busy themselves, building their nests in treetops and caves as they prepare to breed. All the spring babies are fighting for survival though their first days.

programme.title: Wild Iberia S1 - "Summer"
programme.desc: These are the days of thirst: it is hot. Only the mountains are cool; everywhere else suffers in heat between 40 and 50C. The rain is long forgotten. Each day is a search for shade and water.

programme.title: Wild Iberia S1 - "Autumn"
programme.desc: As the woods prepare to sleep, and mushrooms grow as the first rains fall, flocks of cranes migrate home to Spain from their summer season in the north. The stags clash their antlers in pursuit of the does; there is little time before winter sets in.

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Shark Business"
programme.desc: Shark Business unravels some of the mysteries surrounding sharks with controversial behaviorist Dr. Erich Ritter.

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Giants of San Benedicto"
programme.desc: Giants of San Benedicto features Dr. Robert Rubin and his ground-breaking research of giant Mantas. You'll travel to the remote Socorro Islands off Mexico's Pacific coast and see breath-taking encounters with enormous manta rays.

programme.title: Guizhou Golden Monkey & Fanjing Mountains
programme.desc: For the first time, see the incredible images of the Guizhou Golden Monkey population, captured by China’s scientific research station in the Fanjing Mountains and taken over a few years using infrared cameras.

programme.title: Wild Animal Rescue S1 - "Felida Tigers and Lionsrock"
programme.desc: A drama packed mission flying six tigers from the Netherlands to South Africa is hardly off the ground before there’s a medical emergency; and the challenges of treating lions with medical problems.

programme.title: Wild Animal Rescue S1 - "Gaza Lion Cubs Rescue"
programme.desc: International animal rescue organisation FOUR PAWS goes on a dangerous mission into the Gaza Strip to rescue two lion cubs. But tricky negotiations with the lions’ owner, red tape and suspicions create chaos for the team.

programme.title: Wild Animal Rescue S1 - "Restaurant Bears and The Last Wild Horses"
programme.sub-title: Restaurant Bears and The Last Wild Horses
programme.desc: Locked in small cages and used as attractions at small private zoos and even local restaurants, the future of 15 Kosovo bears is bleak if animal rescue organisation FOUR PAWS doesn’t take action.

programme.title: The Last Mahout
programme.desc: This is the story of Sompast, his fight to carry on the legacy of his forefathers, and his quest to train new Mahouts to carry on this noble ancient tradition.

programme.title: China's Swan Lake
programme.desc: ‘China’s Swan Lake’ shows the lives of a whooper swan family living on the vast lake of the Sanmenxia Wetland Park along with invasive black swans and blue herons.

programme.title: Gorillas: A Journey For Survival
programme.desc: Four helpless baby western lowlands gorillas were snatched from their mothers who had been killed by poachers. This film chronicles the steps of returning the ‘Taiping Four’ to their home in Cameroon.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "ELITE CORPS"
programme.desc: Survival demands an edge. Witness some of the animals whose elite sensory abilities put them at the top of their game.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "NAVY SEALS"
programme.desc: In the water, it takes sophisticated navigation systems, fine-tuned reflexes, and high-precision detection methods to survive. These animals have what it takes.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "PATROL"
programme.desc: Life in the wild is life during wartime, and these animal soldiers have mastered the tactics of surveillance, stealth, and attack.

programme.title: Outback Vet S2 - "Shark Mission"
programme.desc: Ed and Dunc launch a post-lockdown mission to restock their aquarium, while Rick uses a pub forklift to weigh a massive Rottweiler.

programme.title: Outback Vet S2 - "The Trip of Two Turtles"
programme.desc: Dr. Katy coordinates the release of two endangered Hawksbill turtles, an amputee pup beats the odds, and Ed sources sustainable squid.

programme.title: To The Rescue S2 - "Without Borders"
programme.desc: Dedicated rescue heroes stop at absolutely nothing to secure human intervention for neglected dogs and guide them to forever families.

programme.title: To The Rescue S2 - "Caribbean Rescue"
programme.desc: Animal rescue expert Jessica Nicodemo specializes in saving vulnerable, at-risk animals from natural disasters and moving them to safety.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 1"
programme.desc: A rhino ear notching goes terribly wrong when a large bull starts attacking the drugged female. Up at the Animal Hospital the world’s tallest patient checks in and the struggle begins to get the baby giraffe to drink.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 2"
programme.desc: Our vet Johan ends up with a buffalo up his backside when one of the animals they are testing for tuberculosis wakes up. We have a difficult decision to make, rescue an orphaned baby elephant or leave it to die a slow, cruel death in the bush.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 3"
programme.desc: The wildlife team comes under attack from an angry rhino after releasing it from its holding crate. Our orphaned baby elephant is settling nicely into his new home and things go crazy when we introduce him to his new playmate, a sheep called Albert.

programme.title: City Zoo S1 - "Big Cats"
programme.desc: In this episode we meet the Big Cats. The zoo crew treats a tiger called Lolo with a toothache. Adrian and Jacquie rescue three teenage lion cubs from an illegal facility and transport them to their new home at City Zoo.

programme.title: City Zoo S1 - "Rhino’s"

programme.title: Till Lies Do Us Part
programme.desc: Amina and Alex announce their engagement to their family and friends after only dating for six months, and are having a destination wedding at that. As the romantic and loving getaway goes along, betrayals and hidden truths come to the surface causing chaos and drama.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Kill For You
programme.desc: Suga, a devoted mother, finds herself opening up to love again when she begins a relationship with Danny, a man who seems genuine and caring. But their connection is quickly tested when she is introduced to Danny’s father, Rusty—a man whose deeply rooted racism creates an undercurrent of tension that can’t be ignored. As Suga tries to navigate the relationship while protecting her son, she begins to sense that something isn’t right beneath the surface.

programme.title: The Housekeeper 2
programme.desc: After moving on from her sordid past, Sharease flourishes in her new life and success. When her son Adonis kidnapped, she seeks help from a ghost of her past to rescue him.

programme.title: Demon Time
programme.desc: William is going through a tumultuous time in his life following the death of his father, and the break up of his girlfriend. As he begins to put his life back together, he discovers his father left behind a substantial debt that could cost him his life. William must face is past, and discover not only his truth, but his father’s as well.

programme.title: Lot Lizards 2: Revenge Route
programme.desc: Destitute and desperate, China is forced to the edge, taking up work as a truck stop sex worker just to survive. Into this grim reality storms Ze, who has come to town seeking vengeance on Angie's sister—the woman who murdered his brother, Tez. But Ze's plans are bigger than just revenge: he aims to rally and recruit every woman working the highway.

programme.title: Thick Trip
programme.desc: Four close-knit friends, all single and yearning for a change, embark on a summer-long 'Queen's Trip' to South Padre, Houston, and the untouched wilderness. As they travel and experience the vibrant cultures and breathtaking landscapes, they confront their fears, rediscover their passions, and explore their own wild sides.

programme.title: Desperate Desires
programme.desc: Marathon runner Mia is pursued by Jay, while Tori and Paul desire a baby. A one-night stand leaves Mia pregnant, creating conflict with Jay and an opportunity for Tori and Paul. When Mia disappears, her grandmother begs Kirkland to find her, forcing him to confront his past. Whose desires will prevail?

programme.title: Cooperating Criminals
programme.desc: Tony's ambition ignites a powder keg of betrayal. Driven by Bianca's manipulation, he pushes his pill operation, ignoring Jay's warnings. As DEA Agent Harrison closes in, Jay battles his past to protect Tony. A dangerous deal with Marco, escalates the chaos, leading to overdose and murder plots. Now, Tony faces a stark choice: witness or prison.

programme.title: Waiting to Process
programme.desc: Four friends—DeShea, Liz, Raven, and Devine—are bound by sisterhood but challenged by the men in their lives. DeShea dates a man with ties to her family, Liz's boyfriend is immature, Raven juggles multiple men, and Devine's husband has a mistress who becomes a deadly threat. As secrets and betrayals test their loyalties, the women must decide if their friendship can survive the chaos.

programme.title: He Killed My Sister
programme.desc: When Malorie's sister, Monica, disappears, everyone around her tells her to grieve and move on. Determined to bring her justice, Malorie embarks on a search for the truth. But when she meets Tyriq, his motives may not be as pure as they seem.

programme.title: Vices
programme.desc: Simone, a married woman battling anxiety and the lingering shadow of her past alcoholism, escapes to collect her thoughts. Surrounded by a web of lies and sin, Simone must face her inner demons before a literal one ends her life.

Ricardo confronta a Celia por su embarazo, rechazando al bebé y negándole su apellido por amor a Manuela. Graciela descubre a Ricardo en casa de Celia y planea delatarlo. Por otro lado, Manuela descubre que está embarazada y celebra con su familia. Hortensia intenta alejar a Misael con dinero, y Moisés busca alejarse de Néstor para proteger su nueva vida.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Marisela grita a Adolfo todo el pasado con Consuelo delante de Junior y Andreína. René, Mariela y Mildred hacen colecta callejera para Carmen pero unos malandros se la roban. Eustoquio amenaza a Isaías por la estafa de los dólares. Adolfo reclama a Erasto por contarle todo a Marisela; Erasto lo expulsa. Natalia decide huir de Erasto y José Luis se ofrece a ayudarla. Rosalía enfrenta furiosa a Consuelo en la tienda exigiendo explicaciones sobre Adolfo. Carmen supera la crisis y Rosa logra verla en cuidados intensivos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Alejandra le pide a Tony que le ponga un aviso a la credencial de entrada a la empresa a Irene, por lo que cuando Irene se presentó a la empresa para poder cobrar su liquidación final Alejandra la cita en su oficina y la trata de una manera muy hiriente. Rebeca contrata a una nueva secretaria para Leonardo para que la mantenga informada sobre todos los movimientos de él en la empresa. María Lucía va a los tribunales para poder averiguar quién fue la persona que le pidió la prueba de paternidad. A no conseguir ninguna información se acerca a la casa de Zulay para pedirle que haga un esfuerzo y le diga el nombre de su verdadero padre. Adolfo, Rebeca y Rodrigo plantan una información falsa de que el atentado contra Juan Pablo que acabó con su muerte fue una maniobra armada por los Samora.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol y Alejandro están en la playa desierta, comienzan a besarse y se confiesan su amor. Luego se van al yate y se quedan ahí hasta que unos ladrones entran y golpean a Sol. Luego uno de ellos le dispara a quemarropa a Alejandro. Columba y Eloy van a hablar con Maricielo, quien les dice que no los perdona. Luego se encuentran con José Domingo y le dicen que tienen que hablar algo con él acerca de Maricielo pero José Domingo se pone ansioso, y Eloy y Columba parecen arrepentidos.

programme.title: La Carretera
programme.desc: Film basado en la espléndida novela de Cormac McCarthy que ganó el premio Pulitzer en 2007. La película nos introduce en un mundo apocalíptico, arrasado por una explosión nuclear, en el cual un padre y su hijo viajan hacia la costa para buscar un lugar seguro donde vivir. Durante su viaje se encontrarán con los pocos seres humanos que quedan.

programme.title: Una Jornada Particular
programme.desc: Emocionante historia del romance sin futuro que en unas pocas horas, el día que se celebra un desfile por la llegada de Hitler a Italia, viven una sacrificada madre de familia y un locutor de radio que ha sido despedido por homosexual.

programme.title: Verano
programme.desc: En el sur de Chile, pequeños acontecimientos moldean la vida de los visitantes y trabajadores de un antiguo balneario termal. Las historias de los protagonistas se conectan en momentos de la vida cotidiana. Mientras los visitantes viven una pausa contemplativa, los habitantes del lugar están inmersos en su rutina. Tras largas horas de vacaciones en la naturaleza, dormir al sol, aprender a conducir, limpiar la casa, besar por primera vez, nadar de noche o simplemente caminar y conversar, el día se despliega lentamente en impresiones de felicidad y descubrimiento.

Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. From Roald Amundsen’s 1911 voyage to the South Pole to Sir Edmund Hillary’s ascent to the summit of Mount Everest to astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin’s history-changing 1969 expedition to the moon, the halls of this institution have echoed with tales of daring discovery and unparalleled human achievement. - That’s why we’re beyond stoked to kick off our Huckberry x The Explorers Club partnership—featuring the Land, Sea, and Space Collection from an exclusive Whiskey Peaks collab and a badass grand prize. programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es la batalla de los espectros porque Bakura desata su ejército de fantasmas contra los feroces zombis de Bonz para poder entrar en la final de la Ciudad de la Batalla. Pero, ¿por quién doblará la campana final cuando jueguen en el Reino de las Sombras?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es un juego de amor porque el rompecorazones de Hollywood, Jean-Claude Magnum, desafía a Mai a un duelo para conseguir su mano. ¿Sucumbirá Mai al encanto de Jean-Claude, por no hablar de su grupo de monstruos ninja?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Que comience la final de la Ciudad de la Batalla! Los ocho finalistas pondrán a prueba su habilidad y resistencia en una arena de duelo a miles de metros de altura.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 1
programme.desc: Es el primer duelo de la final. Yugi se enfrenta al espíritu maligno del Anillo del Milenio que posee a Bakura. Yugi se deshace de los grotescos espectros de Bakura, pero él tiene una estrategia sacada directamente del cementerio…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 2
programme.desc: Bakura activa el Tablero del Destino, que hará que Yugi pierda automáticamente en cinco turnos. Por si fuera poco, el Santuario Oscuro de Bakura daña los puntos de vida de Yugi cada vez que ataca! Sin poder atacar y sin tiempo, Yugi está atrapado.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 3

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La furia de los dioses egipcios
programme.desc: ¡Por fin se revela el origen de las cartas de dioses egipcios! El misterioso Shadi lleva a Yugi a un viaje a través del tiempo hasta la creación de Duelo de Monstruos... ¡y los peligrosos poderes que liberó!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: En el segundo duelo de la final, Odion, disfrazado de Marik, desconcierta a Joey con numerosas trampas para llevar el duelo a un punto muerto. Sin embargo, Joey cuenta con la Tornado Gigante, la contrapartida perfecta que garantiza la victoria de Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Las Encarnaciones de Apophis de Odion se ensañan con los monstruos de Joey... ¡y con sus puntos de vida! ¿Podrá Joey utilizar eficazmente los monstruos que ganó antes en el torneo, o está ya demasiado nervioso para montar un contraataque exitoso?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es un frenesí devorador porque el Serket de Odion devora a los monstruos de Joey para transformarse en poderosas etapas de evolución. ¿Cómo puede Joey derrotar a Serket cuando éste ingiere los monstruos de Joey cada vez que los invoca en el campo?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Odion utiliza una carta de dios egipcio falsa para invocar al tercer monstruo divino egipcio, el Dragón Alado de Ra, y lo utiliza para aniquilar los cinco puntos de vida que le quedan a Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 1
programme.desc: El tercer duelo de la final de la Ciudad de Batalla entre Mai y Marik no es un duelo normal. Es una batalla en el temido Reino de las Sombras donde perder puntos de vida equivale a perder tus recuerdos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 2

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 3

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un duelo con el destino: Kaiba contra Ishizu: Parte 2

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.sub-title: La batalla por el bronce: Parte 3

programme.desc: Es el enfrentamiento decisivo de la Ciudad de la Batalla y el destino del mundo está en juego: ¡Yami Yugi contra Marik! En este retorcido Juego de Sombras, si Yami Yugi pierde, se ira de vacaciones permanentes al Reino de las Sombras.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Ni siquiera con la fuerza de ataque infinita de Obelisco el Atormentador, puede Yugi derrotar al Dragón Alado de Ra.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Téa y Serenity recorren la ciudad del Domino y rememoran las batallas de sus amigos durante la Ciudad de la Batalla. Ahí se dan cuenta de cuánto han madurado y de lo lejos que han llegado... ¡Y de lo mucho que les queda por recorrer!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos están fascinados con las cartas de Duelo de Monstruos del abuelo, pero cuando el duelista número 1 y el despiadado magnate secuestran al abuelo para conseguir la carta del Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules, Yugi deberá enfrentarse a Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Una vez que Yugi y sus amigos llegan al Reino de los Duelistas, Pegasus anuncia que hay muchos secretos extraños en la isla que harán que su último torneo sea diferente a todos los que han conocido.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Después de derrotar la primera oleada de monstruos de duelo de Larva, Yugi se sorprende al descubrir que Larva tiene un último truco bajo la manga: ¡una voraz Gran Polilla que se vuelve más poderosa con cada turno.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey busca un oponente de duelo al que pueda vencer y acaba aceptando valientemente un reto de la veterana duelista Mai.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El pescador duelista y maestro de la baraja marina atrae a Yugi a un duelo en su propio campo de juego marino para obtener una ventaja de campo. ¿Podrá Yugi adaptarse a estos nuevos escenarios para cambiar las tornas de la batalla?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Si Yugi es eliminado del torneo, la malvada Junta Directiva de KaibaCorp entregará el control de la compañía a Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi debe batirse en duelo con un doble mágico de Kaiba creado a partir de la codicia y la sed de poder que Yugi le borró del alma. Yugi tendrá que descubrir una estrategia para sobrevivir al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules de Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi derrota al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules, ¡pero hay dos más esperando en las alas! ¿Llegará el verdadero Kaiba hasta Yugi a tiempo para ayudar a vencer a este imitador?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey decide luchar contra Rex Raptor sin la ayuda de sus amigos para demostrar que es lo suficientemente hombre como para cuidar de Serenity por sí mismo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey se bate con valentía, pero Rex Raptor ha desatado su arma secreta: ¡el Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos! Joey debe descubrir el secreto del regalo de Yugi, la carta del Mago del Tiempo o tendrá que irse del Reino de los Duelistas en el próximo barco.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Bakura, el compañero de clase de Yugi, poseído por los poderes oscuros de su Anillo del Milenio, atrapa a Yugi y a sus amigos en un Juego de Sombras en el que ellos se convierten en las cartas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La luz la final del túnel

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: A pesar de su asombrosa desventaja, Yugi provoca audazmente a PaniK: "Acabaré contigo en tres turnos". ¿Es un farol de Yugi o tiene ventaja en esta batalla de ingenio?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Kaiba baja al reino para enfrentarse a Pegasus! ¿Ha cambiado Kaiba desde su batalla con Yugi o sigue siendo un duelista despiadado? Una batalla entre el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules de Kaiba y el Dragón B de Ojos Rojos de Joey tiene las respuestas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El campo de las almas perdidas: Parte 1
programme.desc: La banda del duelista americano número 1, Bandido Keith, secuestra a Joey y lo lleva a una cueva con un campo de juego en forma de cementerio. Joey se enfrenta a los monstruos zombis de Bandit Keith, que se hacen más fuertes al volver de la tumba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Atrapados en la cueva del laberinto, Yugi y sus amigos encuentran una salida alternativa, pero la puerta está custodiada por los Hermanos Paradox de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Joey aúnan sus fuerzas y consiguen ahuyentar a los monstruos de sus oponentes, pero las cosas están a punto de cambiar cuando los hermanos Paradox invocan al todopoderoso Guardián de la Puerta, ¡un monstruo que refleja todos los ataques!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Joey liberan cada uno su monstruo más fuerte, Calavera Invocada y Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos, pero su fuerza palidece en comparación con el tremendo poder del Guardián de la Puerta.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Utilizando la magia del Ojo del Milenio, Pegasus atrapa el alma de Mokuba dentro de una carta ante la mirada de Kaiba. Para ganarse el derecho a desafiar a Pegasus, Kaiba debe vencer primero a Yugi y hacerse con sus Fichas Estelares.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba convoca al Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules, el monstruo más fuerte del juego compuesto por tres Dragones Blancos de Ojos Azules. Yugi ha perdido todos sus poderosos Monstruos de Duelo, pero un verdadero duelista nunca se rinde.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi comienza a hilar una estrategia para acabar con el Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules, pero debe decidir si reclama la victoria o le perdona la vida a Kaiba. El corazón de Yugi está dividido.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi ha perdido sus Fichas Estelares y su única oportunidad de salvar al abuelo, y está en shock. ¿Podrá Téa hacer que Yugi recupere la conciencia derrotando a Mai para conseguir sus Fichas Estelares extra y enseñar a Yugi el corazón del duelista?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos entran en el castillo y descubren que Kaiba se está preparado para batirse en duelo con Pegaso y que el alma de Mokuba pende de un hilo. El poder del Ojo del Milenio otorga a Pegaso la capacidad de leer la mente de los demás.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba está indefenso ante la baraja del Mundo de Dibujos Animados de Pegaso y sus habilidades para leer la mente. Al final del duelo, Pegasus aprisiona el alma de Kaiba en una carta, al igual que hizo con el abuelo y Mokuba. Yugi está harto.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Bajo la pesada mirada de Pegasus, Yugi se distrae en su duelo con Mai. Después de cometer errores tácticos tontos y permitir que Mai obtenga una gran ventaja con su Dragón Mascota de Arpía, ¿recuperará Yugi su concentración o sucumbirá a tanta presión?
